newsitem.title: USA: Leather Factory forbearance period extended.
newsitem.headline: Leather Factory forbearance period extended.

text.p: Leather Factory Inc said Wednesday it went into default on a loan and has reached an agreement with NationsBank of Texas NA to extend its forebearance period to December 31.
Company Chairman, President and Chief Executive Wray Thompson said the default was the result of "certain financial ratios which became unacceptable under terms of the company's loan agreement."
"I want to emphasize that we have not missed or been late on one payment of principal or interest," Thompson said. "We do not anticipate any problems with payments in the future."
The term facility has a current principal balance of $3.25 million, it said.

During the extended forebearance, the company can continue to use its revolving line of credit as long as there are no further negative changes in its financial ratios and no other events of default occur.
Currently, the company has $400,028 available for further advances under its revolving line of credit.
